confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant anchors are moderately certain for a tourist beach town. Accommodation is less certain and assumes July low-season (southwest monsoon) rates with taxes and service charges included. Beer and wine are the weakest drink anchors because local draft beer is rare and wine markups vary widely. FX: the 0.6955 USD per AUD observation is the RBA 4.00 pm rate for 15 October 2026 as reported in a search summary, not confirmed by opening the RBA page. A 16 October figure from a third-party site was not used because the RBA has not been verified to publish it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on southern Sri Lankan beach resort towns such as Mirissa, Hikkaduwa and nearby Galle, using tourist-area pricing in South Asia. July is the monsoon low season on the southwest coast, so accommodation anchors reflect off-season rates. Drink anchors use the local beer price as a reference point. Cocktail and wine are set at roughly 2x and 2.5x beer respectively, which is a judgement call.
